sourceTitle: Genie 4 is now available on the Gemini API.
originalTitle: Genie 4 is now available on the Gemini API.

blocks.text: Following yesterday's Genie 4 launch, Genie 4 is now available for developers through the Gemini API (via the Interactions API) and Google AI Studio.
blocks.zh: 继昨天的Genie 4发布会之后Genie 4现在通过GeminiAPI(通过互动API)和Google AI Studio可供开发者使用.
blocks.en: Following yesterday's Genie 4 launch, Genie 4 is now available for developers through the Gemini API (via the Interactions API) and Google AI Studio.

blocks.text: Starting from a text prompt, a reference image, or both, developers can experiment with generating continuous 720p worlds at 24fps with synchronized native audio — from ambient soundscapes and sound effects to character dialogue. Using real-time keyboard controls alongside live text prompts, you can navigate environments and change weather, lighting, objects, or events on the fly. Gemini reasoning keeps the world state consistent and coherent throughout.
blocks.zh: 从文字提示开始参考图像,或者两者兼而有之,开发者可以通过同步的本土音频——从环境音景和声音效果到人物对话——在24fps上实验生成连续的720p世界.使用实时键盘控件与实时文本提示,你可以导航环境 和改变天气,照明,对象,或苍蝇上的事件。Gemini推理使世界国家在整个过程中保持一致和连贯.
blocks.en: Starting from a text prompt, a reference image, or both, developers can experiment with generating continuous 720p worlds at 24fps with synchronized native audio — from ambient soundscapes and sound effects to character dialogue. Using real-time keyboard controls alongside live text prompts, you can navigate environments and change weather, lighting, objects, or events on the fly. Gemini reasoning keeps the world state consistent and coherent throughout.

blocks.text: Whether you’re prototyping interactive experiences, visualizing designs for spatial concepts, or training robotics and AI agents, Genie 4 opens up a blank canvas for you to test ideas and define new possibilities. As a reminder every output includes imperceptible SynthID watermarking.
blocks.zh: 无论你是否在创造互动经验,空间概念的可视化设计,或训练机器人和人工智能智能体,Genie 4打开了一张空白的画布,让你测试想法并定义新的可能性.作为提醒,每个输出都包含不易感知的合成ID水标记.
blocks.en: Whether you’re prototyping interactive experiences, visualizing designs for spatial concepts, or training robotics and AI agents, Genie 4 opens up a blank canvas for you to test ideas and define new possibilities. As a reminder every output includes imperceptible SynthID watermarking.

blocks.text: Try the interactive canvas and starter apps in Google AI Studio. Review pricing details and explore the Gemini API documentation to begin building.
blocks.zh: 尝试Google AI Studio中的互动画布和启动程序.审查定价细节,探索GeminiAPI文件开始建设.
blocks.en: Try the interactive canvas and starter apps in Google AI Studio. Review pricing details and explore the Gemini API documentation to begin building.
